valid.name: 'Partial<T>' on a generic type parameter - not flagged, T is not a canonical owned shape

valid.code: type BarType = Partial<{ a: number; b: string }>;
valid.name: 'Partial<{...}>' on an inline object-literal type - not flagged, no named canonical type referenced

valid.code: type FooType = { a: number }; type BarType = Required<FooType>;
valid.name: 'Required<X>' - not flagged, not a subsetting utility (does not hide properties)

valid.code: import type { Rule } from 'eslint'; type BarType = Partial<Rule.RuleModule>;
valid.name: 'Partial<X>' on a type declared in node_modules - not flagged, not a domain shape this codebase owns

valid.code: type FooType = { a: number; b: string }; type BarType = { [K in keyof FooType]: FooType[K] };
valid.name: a full keyof remap is not a subset - not flagged, every property is retained

valid.code: type FooType = { a: number; b: string }; type BarType = { a: FooType['a']; b: FooType['b'] };
valid.name: inline indexed-access reproducing every canonical property is not a subset - not flagged

valid.code: type MyPickType<T, K extends keyof T> = { [P in K]: T[P] };
valid.name: a reusable generic Pick-shaped utility definition itself is not flagged - its own object type is a type parameter, not a canonical owned type

invalid.code: type FooType = { a: number; b: string }; type BarType = Partial<FooType>;
invalid.name: 'Partial<X>' on a local canonical type alias - flagged

invalid.code: type FooType = { a: number; b: string }; type BarType = Pick<FooType, 'a'>;
invalid.name: 'Pick<X, K>' on a local canonical type alias - flagged

invalid.code: interface FooInterface { a: number; method(): void; } type BarType = Omit<FooInterface, 'a'>;
invalid.name: 'Omit<X, K>' on a local canonical interface - flagged

invalid.code: type FooType = { a: number }; function accept(value: Partial<FooType>): void {}
invalid.name: 'Partial<X>' used as a function parameter type - flagged

invalid.code: type MyPickType<T, K extends keyof T> = { [P in K]: T[P] }; type FooType = { a: number; b: string }; type BarType = MyPickType<FooType, 'a'>;
invalid.name: a custom-named alias structurally reimplementing Pick is flagged the same as the literal utility name

invalid.code: type FooType = { a: number; b: string }; type BarType = { [K in 'a']: FooType[K] };
invalid.name: a manual mapped type with zero Omit/Partial/Pick reference is flagged the same as the utility

invalid.code: type FooType = { a: number; b: string; c: boolean }; type BarType = { a: FooType['a']; b: FooType['b'] };
invalid.name: plain inline indexed-access subsetting into fewer than every canonical property is flagged
